step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram shows an automated ML training workflow and an online inference pipeline for personalized recommendations.

1. Workflow & Orchestration:
- EventBridge triggers StepFunctions (State Machine) periodically.
- StepFunctions orchestrates three stages:
  a) Pre-processing: Invokes Lambda (Pre-processing), which queries Athena to extract customer browsing data, which is then stored in S3.
  b) Training: Triggers a SageMaker training job that reads data from S3 and trains a Word2Vec model.
  c) Deployment: Triggers a SageMaker deployment job to update the inference endpoint.

2. User Request / Inference Flow:
- Web Browser (UserConsumerWeb) sends a request to API Gateway.
- API Gateway invokes Lambda (Serving).
- Lambda (Serving) calls the SageMaker endpoint to get item recommendations and returns the results back through API Gateway to the Web Browser.
